facts.fact: The vendor states that streaming TV ad CPMs run $15-35.
facts.quote: Streaming made the economics local: $15-35 CPMs, zip targeting, creative generated free in about two minutes.

facts.fact: The vendor states that TV ad creative can be generated free in about two minutes.
facts.quote: creative generated free in about two minutes

facts.fact: The vendor claims consumers trust TV ads at roughly twice the rate of social ads, without naming a source.
facts.unit: x trust rate vs social ads
facts.quote: consumers trust TV ads at roughly twice the rate of social ads

facts.fact: The vendor recommends running CTV at recognition-building frequency of 3-6 monthly exposures per household.
facts.quote: Run CTV at recognition-building frequency (3-6 monthly exposures per household)

facts.fact: The vendor recommends shifting a business starting from an all-bottom-funnel plan to a 40% top / 20% middle / 40% bottom budget split over two quarters.
facts.quote: shift to 40% top / 20% middle / 40% bottom over two quarters

facts.fact: The vendor recommends a balanced, growing business use a 40-50% top, 25% middle, 25-35% bottom budget split.
The vendor recommends an established brand defending share allocate 50% or more of budget to top-of-funnel.
facts.quote: 50%+ top, with bottom-funnel run as efficient harvest.

facts.fact: The vendor says top-funnel spend should be judged over 90-180 days because of trust mechanics.
facts.quote: give it the 90-180 days the trust mechanics require

facts.fact: The vendor's bottom-heavy diagnostic says lead volume that has plateaued for two or more quarters despite stable or rising spend is a sign the funnel needs a top.
facts.quote: Lead volume has plateaued for two-plus quarters

facts.fact: The vendor advises that three or more of its five bottom-heavy diagnostic signs indicate the funnel needs a top-of-funnel investment.
facts.quote: Three or more of these, and another dollar of search spend is the wrong dollar.

facts.fact: Consumers report trusting TV ads at roughly double the rate of social ads, according to the page.
facts.quote: consumers report trusting TV ads at roughly double the rate of social ads

facts.fact: A business transitioning from search-only does well at roughly 40% top-funnel, 20% middle-funnel, and 40% bottom-funnel budget split, reached over a quarter or two.
facts.quote: A business transitioning from search-only does well at roughly 40% top, 20% middle, 40% bottom, reached over a quarter or two rather than overnight.

facts.fact: The page describes a 90%+ bottom-funnel budget split as the wrong split for funnel allocation.
facts.quote: The wrong split is the common one: 90%+ bottom, which buys an efficient harvest of a field nobody is planting.

facts.fact: Top-funnel investment shows first as branded-search and direct-traffic lift within 30-60 days.
facts.quote: The top-funnel investment shows first as branded-search and direct-traffic lift in 30-60 days

facts.fact: Growing lead volume from created demand typically appears in 90-180 days, per the page.
facts.quote: then as growing lead volume in 90-180 days as created demand ripens

facts.fact: The page gives an example small-budget funnel of $1,500 per month across three zip codes, split $600 CTV, $300 synchronized social and retargeting, and $600 search.
facts.quote: A $1,500 monthly budget runs a real funnel in three zip codes: $600 CTV, $300 synchronized social and retargeting, $600 search.

facts.fact: The page states that the center of the funnel machine takes about two minutes to switch on.
facts.quote: The center of the funnel machine takes about two minutes to switch on.
